ns2:section.sectionText: Love and Performance. How do we tell the truth about love? What is love? How does it work? What’s love got to do with anything, with politics, with performance? In order to critically consider the philosophical, physical, and aesthetic manifestations of love, we will turn to texts ranging from critical theory, poetry, love letters between writers, artists and philosophers, and aesthetic sites including performance art, popular music, dance, and drama to analyze different ways of seeking and giving affection. Importantly, we will also examine what it entails to love another or “an other” across difference, turning to how race, gender, sexuality, and nation wonderfully complicate expressions of love.
